title: Anyone else's Mall World almost always underground? And expand into a city?
content: I've noticed that I've been in the Mall World a HECK of a lot more frequently recently. I've also noticed that it's almost all underground. If it's not underground, then it's very dark and cloudy, or I have the feeling that the sky is just a gray ceiling and the sun is a hole in the ceiling. I've also been through a back alley in the Mall World that sells really good burritos, if there's anyone there to serve me, or if the line is short enough, but it's much darker and grungier down there. Then there's a Chinese food place that will rip you off, charging 16 dollars for a bowl of white rice. There's also the feeling that it's connected to a underground city, which I accessed after being pulled into it by people made of flames in a giant fireplace at my childhood home (it hurt) and the city is full of "angels" (which may secretly be demons) and they like to whisper to each other all the time, particularly about me when I walk by and look up at the fake sky and wonder why everyone else has their head down. It's also connected to this REALLY creepy place that is a labyrinth of industrial like tunnels, huge rooms and full of pipes with water. I strongly believe this area is full of incredibly terrifying monsters, but I've never seen one. Perhaps I'M the monster or it's full of confused and scared people who all think that other confused and scared people are monsters, when they're not. In addition to this, there's the feeling that spaces aren't real, like some of the buildings are just facades. My theory? This place is basically Hades, given that it's underground. It's like a holding place for all the dead people. Why I keep going there, I don't know. I have not seen the sun in my dreams in a very long time.
